newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya coffee prices weaker at weekly auction.
newsitem.headline: Kenya coffee prices weaker at weekly auction.

text.p: Kenyan coffee prices fell by an average of $20 at the weekly coffee auction in Nairobi following a weak overseas market, auction officials said.
Grade Cs averaged $251 per 50-kg (110 lb) from $278 last week, while grade ABs $271 from $291. Grade AAs averaged $276 from $295.
The Coffee Board of Kenya said it sold all 45,000 60-kg bags on offer compared to 45,759 sold last week. --Wambui Chege, Nairobi Newsroom ++254-2 330-261.
